title: Guru Nanak Jayanti greeting
hook: Wishing you a peaceful and joyful Gurpurab.
caption:
Wishing you a peaceful and joyful Gurpurab.

On Guru Nanak Jayanti we remember a simple teaching: work honestly, share what you have, and serve others without asking who they are.

May your day be filled with light, langar and the people you love.

Warm wishes from all of us at Galvor.
alt_text: Festival card in Galvor violet and gold with a sparkle motif. It reads Happy Gurpurab, then: wishing you light, seva and togetherness. Below: from all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: Wishing you light, *seva* and togetherness.
slides.sub: From all of us at Galvor.
